extracted.intended_audience: students, instructors, researchers, and readers looking for errata/corrections for mathematics textbooks
extracted.subtask_description: A community-maintained directory of links to errata and corrections for mathematics textbooks, organized by subject area; includes a short instruction for how to report new errata. Useful as a reference for readers seeking known corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report math Errata
rubrics_metrics.description: If you know about any math errata, comment it in this mathoverflow post.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page directs contributors to report errata via the referenced MathOverflow post. Associated tags shown on the page include: correction, corrections, errata, errata_database, and specific author/book tags (e.g., john_lee, loring_tu). No further submission formatting or eligibility criteria are provided on this page.
